items.material_issue: The long lore narrative is faithfully rendered: key quantities (twenty-fold demand, thirty times agreed payment), causality (Dwarves manipulating the king, halfling raids provoked by the attacks), and plot facts (Drake's succession, the dust-scattered stralite threat) are all preserved. Minor renderings ("Army of Rogues" as 游击军, "struck a 30x-price agreement" for "agreed to pay thirty times") keep the substantive meaning.
items.evidence: "be increased twenty-fold" → 提高到原来的二十倍; "agreed to pay thirty times the previous amount" → 以30倍的价钱; "manipulated the king into mining it... for a fraction of its true worth" → 利用这个国王去开采并以一个极低的价格卖给他们.

items.material_issue: Meaning fully preserved: %d turns lived across three timelines, and the question of which to make the real timeline matches the three-answer chat ("The first/second/third.").
items.evidence: "You have lived %d turns in three different timelines" → 在三条不同的时间线里度过了 %d 个回合; "the real timeline" → 现实时间线.

items.material_issue: The answer to the Eidolon's "Are you sure?" retains its polarity and meaning: refusing death because life may still be worth living.
items.evidence: "No actually, perhaps life is still worth it!" → 不，其实生命或许依然值得活下去！

items.material_issue: Meaning preserved. "Slot opens" matches the later "Slot slams shut" (small opening → 小洞); the disbelief that the player could hold the long-lost Orb of Many Ways is conveyed by 你拿到的肯定不是多元水晶球.
items.evidence: "Surely you don't possess the Orb of Many Ways! It's been lost for ages!" → 你拿到的肯定不是多元水晶球！它已经消失很多年了！

items.material_issue: The too-late reaction is preserved: %s already finished, grudging acceptance of the ingredients and an undeserved reward. The added 原料 ("ingredients") is confirmed by the fixed source's check_ingredients turn-in logic.
items.evidence: "You're too late. %s has already finished" → 你来太晚了。%s已经完成了; "undeserved reward" → 你不配得到的奖励.

items.material_issue: The player's explanation (heard cries, the men were in the way, asking what is happening) is fully preserved.
items.evidence: "I heard some cries, and your men... they were in my way. What's going on here?" → 我听到了呼喊声，而你的人……挡了我的路。这里发生了什么事？

items.material_issue: The Chinese accurately reflects the fixed source's actual condition: Gestalt must be active AND (a psi damage shield active OR Improved Gestalt not on cooldown). It even makes the Gestalt-active requirement explicit.
items.evidence: Source code: "if not self:isTalentActive(self.T_GESTALT) or (not self:hasEffect(self.EFF_PSI_DAMAGE_SHIELD) and self:isTalentCoolingDown(self.T_IMPROVED_GESTALT))"; target: 必须在格式塔处于激活状态，并且有一个精神护盾或强化格式塔不在冷却中.

items.material_issue: The pre-arena inspection of the ranking boards and the %s insertion point are preserved.
items.evidence: "You take a look at the ranking boards before entering.\n%s" → 进入竞技场前，你查看了一下排名榜。\n%s

items.material_issue: Recognition line preserved: the speaker identifies the other as the apprentice mage met in the wilds; the follow-up chat confirms the referent.
items.evidence: "You're that apprentice mage I met in the wilds!" → 你不就是那个荒野之中的法师学徒么？

items.material_issue: The gold cost statement and the %d placeholder are preserved verbatim in meaning.
items.evidence: "This costs %d gold." → 这将花费%d金币。

items.material_issue: In the race features list, "runes and infusions" is rendered as 纹身和符文 ("tattoos and runes"): "infusions" — a distinct ToME inscription/item category (注入), separate from runes — is mistranslated as 纹身 (tattoo), a category that does not exist, materially obscuring which item types the racial efficiency applies to.
items.evidence: Source: "- Efficient at using all kind of runes and infusions"; target: "- 善于使用各种纹身和符文" (infusions → 纹身, while the body text correctly uses 刻印 for inscriptions).

items.material_issue: "Yeeks" — the specific ToME creature race Hompalan uses as servants/test subjects — is mistranslated as 夺心魔 (mind flayers), changing the referent of a narrative fact: readers will believe a different monster species served as the servants and early test subjects.
items.evidence: Source: "I'll be glad to get rid of these disgusting yeeks... Why we ever decided to use these useless creatures as servants"; target: 能摆脱这些令人作呕的夺心魔真让我高兴...让这些无用的生物当仆从; fixed context confirms yeeks were the creatures sent through before humans.

items.material_issue: The Necromancer's boast is fully preserved: the unfinished but functional guardian, its near-invulnerability once complete, the next minion to animate, and the triumphant closing rhetoric.
items.evidence: "While it remains unfinished, it is finished enough to serve in its purpose of protecting my lair" → 虽然尚未彻底完成，却已经足以履行守卫我巢穴的使命; "What can possibly stop me now" → 如今还有什么能阻止我.

items.material_issue: The alchemist's pleased reaction is preserved: handing over the items, the rival %s having created a %s during the player's long absence, and the fear of losing his rightful spot.
items.evidence: "in your overlong absence, %s has managed to create a %s" → 在你离开的漫长时间里，%s已经设法配制出了一瓶%s; "steals my rightful spot" → 抢走了本该属于我的席位.
